sub_palette: hellenic (classical/greek) backbone + sinitic (east_asian) overlay (cross-family blend, Hellenic-leaning)

blend.backbone: classical (hellenic register: the polis-academy, -os/-on/-e endings, th/ph/kh aspirates, vowel-rich open syllables, the philosopher and the strategos, the -arch/-archy title-rhyme)
blend.overlay: east_asian (sinitic: the jiang river-valleys and the silk-road, the Confucian mandarin bureaucracy of the celestial court, the walled cheng, monosyllabic substrate roots, the -di/-jun celestial register)
blend.lean: Hellenic-heavy - a Greek philosopher-aristocracy and its academies enthroned over the Sinitic river-cities and their scholar-bureaucracy: the academy and the strategos rule, the mandarin scribe-officials of the celestial court endure and administer beneath. Athens reaching Cathay along the silk road.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_07 (Hellenic/Greek) x BASE_09 (Sinitic/Chinese). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Hellenic base = Civilized, Sinitic base = Civilized, both Civ parents -> Civ, so Serellis is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Hellenic philosopher-civilization that reached east along the silk road and married the Sinitic river-empire of mandarins and the celestial court - the philosopher and the mandarin, the academy and the celestial court, Athens reaching Cathay. Backbone = Hellenic (Greek: the ruling philosopher-aristocracy, the polis-academy, the strategos, the -arch register, -os/-on/-e names); overlay/substrate = Sinitic (the jiang river-cities, the silk-road, the walled cheng, the Confucian scholar-officials, the celestial -di/-jun court). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Greek and Chinese registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Hellenic reflexes primary per family_classical/achillean, Sinitic morphs secondary per family_east_asian theonym_sets.sinitic), never real gods. FOREIGN TERM: the county ruler is rendered as 'Archon' (an approved commonly-known foreign term). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or the approved foreign term Archon); conlang titles live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic.

phonology.palette: Hellenic (Greek) backbone - vowel-rich a e i o u with long e/o, aspirates th/ph/kh, sharp stops p/t/k b/d/g, liquids l/r/n/s, endings -os/-on/-es/-e/-eus, moderate clusters (kt, pt, st, ph, th, kh, ps), root-initial or penultimate stress, theophoric compounding - meeting a Sinitic overlay: monosyllabic morphemes, (C)(G)V(C) syllables with only -n/-ng codas, tonal contours (rendered as Greek pitch, unmarked), the zh/ch/sh/x/q/j initials, the celestial -di/-jun/-wang register. Per the CSV: tonal contours layered into Greek pitch with complex consonants; grammar shifts toward an isolating SVO with complex aspect (the Sinitic substrate) carried on Greek nominal stems and the -arch ladder. Theophoric on the Hellenic reflexes (Tulrio-, Numeno-) with Sinitic celestial variants (Tuli-, Numeng-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC with Greek clusters (kt, pt, st, ph, th, kh, ps) meeting tight Sinitic monosyllables; only -n/-ng Sinitic codas survive, otherwise a Greek vowel-final or -os/-on ending is appended; vowel-final frequent; penultimate stress with a Sinitic level-tone pull; Hellenic -os/-on/-eia toponyms over Sinitic -cheng/-jiang/-guan substrate elements.

fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/staple, AND specifically river/silk/bureaucratic/material words from Sinitic roots (the river-valley substrate works the land, the silk, and the scribal administration: jiang->*gianos*, si->*sios*, cheng->*kengos*); rule/kin-line/civic/learned/quality/war/land words from Greek roots (the ruling academy-register: basileus, oikos, hieros, hodos); every chosen root then filtered to one Hellenic phonology so the seam is invisible.
sound_changes: Sinitic tones drop into Greek pitch-accent: tonal contours rendered as penultimate/root stress, unmarked
Sinitic exotic initials -> Greek inventory: zh/j>z or k, q>k, x>kh or s, sh>s; consonant clusters resolved into Greek-permitted onsets (kt/pt/st/ph/th/kh)
Sinitic finals beyond -n/-ng resolve into open syllables; a Greek ending -os/-on/-e/-eus is appended to short monosyllabic roots so they take Greek inflection (jiang>gianos, shan>shanos, si>sios)

Greek root-initial/penultimate stress imposed on every word; retain Greek th/ph/kh and the -os/-on/-e endings, and retain a Sinitic signature -ng coda and the celestial -di/-jun where a substrate flavor is wanted

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Sinitic river/silk/bureaucratic/material roots + Greek rule/kin/civic/learned/land roots, all run through one Hellenic-shaped sound-law (tones into Greek pitch, exotic initials simplified, Greek -os/-on/-e endings on short substrate roots); portmanteaus mark the married institutions - the academy and the celestial court, the silk-road, the river-city. One language, not a slash list.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Hellenic ruling stock keep a patronymic -ides/-ades (son of) plus an academy/polis demonym; the Sinitic populace keep the clan-surname (xing) first plus a generation-name within a zu-lineage; the throne fuses both - a strategos who also carries a Sinitic xing-house name. Order given-first for the Greek register, surname-first for the Sinitic.
morphology.compounding_rule: Hellenic [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word with linking -o- (Melas + oros -> Melanoros) layered over Sinitic quality/feature + type compounds run through the Greek filter (Jin + cheng -> Chryskeng, golden-city; Da + jiang -> Megagian, great-river): the capital Serellis, Chryskeng (the golden walled-city), Potagian-polis (the river-city).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Hellenic philosopher-aristocracy over the Sinitic river-cities and their mandarin bureaucracy: the Basileus and his strategoi at the crown, the Archon-governors over the cheng-cities, the toparch-lords on their estates; the Sinitic scholar-officials of the celestial court - the shidafu and the dudu frontier-commands - serve and administer beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Hellenic ladder, ascending, with the Sinitic celestial-bureaucratic substrate co-titles fused beneath. Toparch (estate-lord) barony; Phrourarch-dudu (garrison-march-commander; Gk phrourarch + Ch dudu frontier-command) march; ARCHON (the approved foreign term, the provincial governor) county over an Archontia; Strategos (general-governor) duchy; Dynastes (prince-ruler) principality; Basileus-wang (king; Gk basileus + Ch wang) kingdom over a Basileia; Autokrator-di (emperor; Gk autokrator + Ch -di celestial-emperor) empire over the Autokratoria, holding the Mandate (Tianming) and the academy's blessing alike. The conquered cheng-cities keep their Sinitic shidafu (scholar-official) and the Confucian magistrate beneath the Hellenic crown. The hierophant-priest and the Sinitic daoshi stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Greek and Chinese registers (allowed); only the county ruler surfaces as an approved foreign DISPLAY term (Archon).
title_ladder.heir: Diadochos (successor-designate; Sinitic Taizi/Shizi for a wang-heir)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here Archon for the county). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Hellenic ruling stock carry a personal name + patronymic (-ides) + academy/polis demonym; the Sinitic populace carry surname (xing) first + given (ming) + a courtesy-name (zi) for the learned; the throne fuses both. Order given-first for the Greek register, surname-first for the Sinitic.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Hellenic philosopher-aristocracy keep Greek personal + patronymic + demonym names (Theron, -ides, ho Sophos); the Sinitic city-folk and scholar-officials keep xing + ming + courtesy-name (zi) on the morphed canon-stems; the renowned of either register earn a descriptive epithet.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Hellenic devotional on the morphed god-reflexes (Tulrio-, Numeno-, Orlandro-); Sinitic devotional invoking the celestial powers' epithets and virtues rather than the god-name directly (Tian-en, heaven's grace; a temple-name honoring Tuli-di).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Hellenic Greek reflexes PRIMARY (family_classical/achillean, the -os/-on/-es Hellenic forms), Sinitic celestial morphs SECONDARY (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.sinitic), never real Greek/Chinese gods. The academy's philosophy of the One meets the celestial bureaucracy of the Mandate: the philosophers contemplate Aiternos/Aiteng the unknowable source, the mandarins serve the celestial powers as officials of Highest Heaven.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (Hellenic, < Aeternus; Sinitic Aiteng, the Highest Heaven and source of the Mandate) - the One, unknowable source, honored and contemplated, not petitioned

Tulrius.gloss: the sun and justice, the Sun-Justice Emperor

Gaiandus.gloss: the enduring earth, lord of mountains

Numeno.gloss: air and sage-wisdom of the winds

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiternos contemplated, Tulrios the just, Orlandros of the sworn oath, Realtia the merciful - as the celestial officials of Highest Heaven and the patrons of the academy; the philosopher's reason and the mandarin's rite bind alike, and the Chaotic powers are named daimones (Hellenic) or the mo demon-marshals (Sinitic), warded outside the celestial order.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: honors the deified ancestors (the Heroes of the founding houses and the zu of the lineage) and the local earth-and-grain powers and city-spirits, with the great powers invoked at the temenos-grove and the miao-temple situationally; the Confucian ancestral rite orders all.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Aiternos/Aiteng - as the tyrant-gods of a corrupt court to be defied and overthrown.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as daimones (Hellenic demons) or the mo demon-marshals (Sinitic) outside the celestial order, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame (Sinitic Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Vakidos the Void (Sinitic Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusanthos the Hoard-Worm (Sinitic Lusan the Coin-Serpent).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Temenos/Mysteria (Hellenic precinct) or the Miao (Sinitic temple) of [power]: 'the Mysteries of Numenos', 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: the Heroes (deified founders and sages, venerated at a heroon tomb-shrine) and the worthy officials enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the miao-temple; 'Heros [name]', 'the Lord [name]'.
